The document, in the tree's own shape: Summary, Requirements as REQ-N, Acceptance Criteria as AC-N each citing the REQ it discharges, Architecture, Open Questions, Out of Scope. An AC states the artifact that must exist and what it must contain, so it can be checked by someone who did not write it. No TODO, no TBD. Where a stage retreats, pre-plan the retreat order rather than improvising it.

```day-atom
{"in":["spike-result","probe-verdict"],"out":["design-doc"],"next":["requirement-register"]}
```
